Finding: Three of fourteen staging tables (patient_contact, appointment_notes, support_notes) contained unmasked production data. The masking pipeline did not detect the exclusion created by a February 2027 schema change.
Correction: Affected tables masked and staging refresh re-run on 2027-04-20; verification query confirmed no production values.
Corrective action: Add a masking coverage test that fails the refresh if any table is unmasked; perform quarterly sample verification and report coverage in the KPI pack.
Closure evidence: Masking coverage report and refresh log

Finding: One of six leavers sampled had an active Freshdesk agent account 19 days after the last working day. Google, AWS, and GitHub access had been removed on time. No post-termination activity was found.
Correction: Freshdesk account disabled and sessions revoked on 2027-04-17.
Corrective action: Add Freshdesk and all SaaS tools to the offboarding checklist; reconcile the HR leaver list with SaaS accounts monthly; automate deprovisioning through SCIM where available.
Closure evidence: Updated checklist; April reconciliation record; account disable log

Finding: Two of seven tier 1 suppliers (VideoBridge and Pixelwave) had no completed security assessment at the audit date. The Pixelwave contract had been revised and access restricted; the VideoBridge DPA was signed.
Correction: Pixelwave assessment completed 2027-04-20. VideoBridge assessment due 2027-04-30.
Corrective action: Complete both assessments; add supplier reviews to the annual calendar with named owners; report tier 1 completion monthly in KPI-14.

Finding: Threat intelligence is informal: vendor advisories and GuardDuty findings are reviewed, but there is no collection plan, defined requirements, or record of how intelligence changes priorities.
Corrective action: Define three to five intelligence requirements and a monthly review record; link outputs to vulnerability and supplier decisions.

Finding: Endpoint protection is present (Windows Defender and macOS protections) but there is no endpoint detection and response capability.
Correction: No immediate correction required; compensating controls include MDM, encryption, and email filtering.
Corrective action: Deploy EDR on all managed endpoints in Q3 2027 and include coverage in KPI reporting.

Finding: Classification labels are applied to new documents, repositories, and ticket templates, but legacy documents and some SaaS records are unlabelled.
Corrective action: Label documents on touch; add a classification field to document and ticket templates; sample quarterly.

Finding: The Q1 restore test proved recovery in the primary region, but cross-region restore has not been tested. The platform runs in a single AWS region with cross-region backups.
Correction: No immediate correction required; DR plan documents the strategy.
Corrective action: Perform a cross-region restore test by 2027-06-15 and update RTO evidence.

Finding: Access review evidence is collected manually from multiple systems, which increases effort and the risk of omission.
Corrective action: Automate user-list export and HR comparison; retain a single review record per cycle.

Finding: Control testing is concentrated in the annual internal audit rather than sampled through the year.
Corrective action: Add quarterly design and operating effectiveness testing for a rotating sample of controls to the KPI pack.
